data.credibility: Management generally hits their stated volume and margin targets, delivering mid-single-digit value growth (4.9%) and commissioning projects on schedule while maintaining PBDIT margins within the guided 18-20% band.

lines.line: Promised mid-single-digit value growth; delivered 4.9% for FY26.
Targeted 8-10% volume growth for Q4; delivered 12.4%.
Guiding 18-20% PBDIT margin; current actual is 18.2%.
Targeting high single-digit volume growth for FY27; currently on track.
Promised H1 FY27 VAM-VAE commissioning; delivered successfully.
Aiming for 150,000 MT VAE capacity over 2-2.5 years; on track.

bull: Operating cash flow was robust at 109% of reported profit over the past five years, showing strong cash conversion.
The company maintains a healthy return on equity of 21.8% and a ROCE of 26.3% with light gearing (debt-to-equity 0.21).
Management successfully delivered on volume growth targets, achieving 12.4% in Q4 FY26 against a targeted 8-10%.
bear: Revenue growth has slowed down significantly to 1.0% annually over three years compared to 10.4% over five years.
EBITDA margin has narrowed from 22.4% in FY21 to 18.8% in FY26.
Borrowings have risen noticeably from ₹1,093 cr in FY21 to ₹4,596 cr against a net worth of ₹21,735 cr.
